messages:
rhea: Staging alerted: sudden 502 spike on /api/v1/embeds after the quant rebase. Looks like payload serializer header drift. Need a hotfix image and pin to stop noisy failures in prod. Suggest `gcr.io/redwood/release/embed-fix:hotfix-2024-07-15`.

deploybot: Deploy request queued (ID=dr-1147). Approvals required: oncall + release-manager. Canary suggested: 3m. expedited=true, safe-rollout=true.

marcus: Oncall here, I can watch. What's the observed blast radius? Any downstream batchers that could retry amplify?

rhea: In staging ~6% of short-sequence embeds hit 502s. Prod route sees ~0.4% traffic but batch pipelines could amplify under backoff. Proposed rollback triggers: error_rate increase >= 1.8% sustained 4m OR p95 latency > 750ms for 5m.

rhea: Rollback snippet:
```
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/embed-service embed=gcr.io/redwood/release/embed:2024-07-11
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/embed-service
# emergency
kubectl -n inference rollout undo deploy/embed-service --to-revision=68
```

toni: Infra +1 for a 8m midwindow starting 20:12 UTC. Need release notes URL, configmap hash, and the short CV blurb for release-manager. @rhea can you add the canary evidence?

rhea: Canary in staging ran 16m after small tweak, no regressions. Grafana snapshots uploaded to the release doc. Release note: https://docs.redwood.com/releases/embed-2024-07-15-serializer-drift (one-liner: fix serializer header drift after quant rebase; pin hotfix image; include rollback criteria). Configmap hash: `cfg-9f2b1c`.

release-bot: Release doc validated. Changelog entry created: "embed: serializer header fix (hotfix-2024-07-15)". Attachments: grafana_screenshots.zip.

rhea: deploybot, kick the expedited deploy: `deploybot expedite --id dr-1147 --force --midwindow 8m --notify #eng-releases,#incidents`

deploybot: Expedited deploy scheduled: dr-1147 -> prod. Canary: 3m, then progressive rollout. Midwindow reserved 8m starting 1747778915. Monitors: /metrics/embeds/error_rate, embeddings.p95, kvcache.hit_rate. Watchers: marcus, toni, rhea. Logs tail: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=k8s_container AND resource.labels.cluster_name=prod" --limit 75`

ops-bot: Alerting ramp: 25s. Bound runbook: /runbooks/embed-serializer-drift. Pager rules: if error_rate > 1.8% for 4m -> page ops-lead and post to #incidents.

marcus: Oncall ACK. I'll watch p95 and error_rate; if we breach I'll run the rollback snippet and page #incidents.

rhea: Thanks all. Will follow up with a short blameless note and link to the postmortem once stabilized. :white_check_mark:
